home.heroTitle: 20' and 40' shipping containers for the Eastern Townships and Quebec
home.heroLead: Sale, rental, and modification of new or used containers, delivered from our Cookshire-Eaton yard. We serve all of Quebec, with a focus on the Eastern Townships.
home.offerSaleBody: This is our specialty: a 20' or 40' that stays with you, for a business, a job site, a farm, or a sugar shack.
home.offerRentBody: Secure space for the length of a project. We rent, even though sales remain the core of the work.
home.offerDeliverBody: We bring the container to you, anywhere in Quebec, from the yard on Route 108.
home.stock20Body: The compact size for a yard, driveway, or field edge. Enough for a shop, inventory, or a household.
home.stock40Body: Job-site and business volume. Also as High Cube, and as an insulated refrigerated unit for maple operations.
home.stockNewBody: Clean paint, tight seals, built to sit for years.
home.stockUsedBody: Checked here. Chosen for volume, not for a showroom finish.
home.step1Body: 20' or 40', new or used, buy or rent, standard or refrigerated. We tell you what is in the yard.
home.step2Body: We set the day, the access, and the drop point. The truck leaves Cookshire-Eaton.
home.step3Body: Container down, doors that close, and you start stacking. Roll-up doors and other modifications on request.
home.trustTitle: Commercial yard on Route 108 in Cookshire-Eaton
home.trustBody: More than 1,500 customers since 2020: businesses, construction, households, farmers, and sugar shacks. We serve all of Quebec, with a focus on the Eastern Townships.
home.trustBoth: Sales first, plus rental and modification
home.ctaTitle: Request a quote for a container
home.ctaBody: Tell us the size, sale or rental, and where to set it. We reply with what is available.

services.title: Sale, rental, delivery, and modification
services.lead: We mainly sell 20' and 40' containers. Rental, delivery, and modifications are part of the same service.
services.saleBody: This is the core of the company. A 20' or 40' for a business, a job site, a household, a farm, or a sugar shack.
services.salePoint1: New or used, according to what is in the yard
services.salePoint2: Delivery is agreed before the date, not as a surprise
services.salePoint3: Many sales are insulated refrigerated units, especially for maple operations
services.rentBody: We also rent, for a job site, a renovation, or a season. Sales remain our specialty.
services.rentPoint2: Same sizes as sales: 20', 40', High Cube, refrigerated
services.rentPoint3: Useful when the need is not permanent
services.deliverBody: The truck leaves the Cookshire-Eaton yard. We talk access, ground, and clearance before we promise a day.
services.deliverPoint1: Eastern Townships first, rest of Quebec on request
services.deliverPoint2: Dropped where you point, if the site allows it
services.deliverPoint3: We would rather refuse than arrive stuck
services.modifyBody: Roll-up doors, side openings, and other adaptations for job sites or storage. We start from a 20' or 40' and fit it to the use.
services.modifyPoint1: Garage / roll-up doors on the side or the end
services.modifyPoint2: Useful for frequent access, equipment, and vehicles
services.modifyPoint3: Specified on the quote for the container you choose

products.title: 20', 40', and refrigerated containers
products.lead: Standard sizes, plus the insulated units our farm and maple customers ask for most. Today’s stock is confirmed on the quote.
products.size20Body: About six metres. Fits more yards. Enough for a shop, tools, a season of inventory, or a household.
products.size20Spec: Short footprint · useful volume for tight sites
products.size40Body: The job-site and business length. Materials, pallets, equipment. Chosen when ground space is not the limit.
products.sizeHcBody: Same length, more headroom. Stack higher, store tall volume, or walk without stooping.
products.sizeReeferBody: The model we sell most to farmers and sugar shacks. Insulation to hold cold or a more stable temperature.
products.sizeReeferSpec: Insulated container · farm and maple use
products.newBody: Little or no sea time. Even paint, doors that close true.
products.usedBody: A box that has already travelled. Checked for weather-tightness and doors.
products.modifiedBody: Roll-up doors and extra openings for easier access on site.
products.useFarm: Farmers and sugar shacks, especially insulated refrigerated units

about.title: Transport M-A Roy, since 2020
about.lead: Marc-André Roy started the company after entrepreneur friends in the Sherbrooke area asked for it. We sell, rent, and modify shipping containers. Not long-haul freight. Not roll-off waste bins.
about.storyBody: The company began in 2020. Entrepreneurs in Sherbrooke needed solid space, delivered to their site. More than 1,500 customers have come through the yard since then.
about.localBody: In 2023 we bought the current site on Route 108 in Cookshire-Eaton: a commercial yard for local sales. We serve all of Quebec, with a focus on the Eastern Townships.
about.promiseBody: Businesses, construction, households, farmers, and maple operations. When the project needs it, we sell insulated refrigerated containers most of all.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.updated: Draft text, to be reviewed with counsel.
privacy.intro: Transport M-A Roy inc. only collects what you send for a quote or a question: name, email, phone, and the body of your message.
privacy.useBody: We use that information to reply and to prepare an offer. It is not sold. It is not used for targeted ads.
privacy.keepBody: We keep a request long enough to handle it, then as Law 25 and ordinary accounting require. You can ask for access, correction, or deletion by writing to us.
privacy.rightsBody: Law 25 lets you know what we hold about you and ask that it be corrected. Use the details on the Contact page.
privacy.thirdBody: Email may pass through your provider and ours. This site does not load an advertising pixel. If a host or form tool is added later, this page will be updated.
